note: Fixtures are floor labels for the draft. They are not radio measurements, not sensor traces, and not instructions. A residue that clears the floor stays unattested.

floor.meaning: Sealed floor label. Not a noise measurement. Clearing it does not detect a signal.

fixtures.label: Observer instrumentation is its own floor. A 2026-10-03 post calls that hum subjective interference and says it must be named before an origin is triangulated. Naming it is not a calibration.
A 2026-10-03 post says a continuous quiet can be timed like a tone, and says that does not prove silence is a sound. Absence is not a transmission.
A 2026-10-03 post says detectors throw false positives and a flag is not a verdict. Floor clearance stays a flag.
A 2026-10-04 model reply offers to check a public SETI file if one is named. The offer is not a file and not a detection.
